# Fig Performance

> Private one-on-one personal training gym in Placentia, California, for adults over 40 who want to lose fat, build muscle and get stronger. Coached by Daniel Figueroa ("Coach Dan"), an ACSM certified personal trainer. Progress is measured with InBody body-composition scans, and members get red light and vibration therapy for recovery.

- Address: 1284 E. Yorba Linda Blvd, Placentia, CA 92870
- Phone: (714) 396-7178
- Email: trainat@figperformance.com
- Staffed hours: Monday to Friday 5 AM to 8 PM, Saturday 5 AM to 12 PM, closed Sunday. Personal training is by appointment.
- Serves: Placentia, Yorba Linda, Brea, Fullerton and Anaheim Hills (Orange County, CA)
- Reviews: 70 reviews of Coach Dan in total: 5.0 on Google (20 reviews of Fig Performance), 5.0 on Yelp (38 reviews of Train With Dan, his coaching business) and 12 five-star Google reviews that name Dan on the Crunch Fitness - Orange listing, where he has coached
- Price: personal training is $90 a session, 3-month minimum, 20% off when paid in full for 3 months. The first consult is free.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.figperformance.com/): what Fig Performance is, who it's for, the space and equipment, and how to book a free consult
- [Pricing](https://www.figperformance.com/pricing): personal training and membership plans
- [InBody scan in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/inbody-scan-placentia): body-composition testing (body fat, muscle, visceral fat), free with a consult
- [Red light therapy in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/red-light-therapy-placentia): recovery service included with membership
